text:
Alex (Account Executive): Hey team — Velos POC needs a short-lived hosted API key for tomorrow's demo. They want: limited scope (inference only), IP allowlist for their office, TTL ~8h, and rotation + revoke ops documented. Can someone provision or share the exact command? @Maria fyi.
Maria (Solutions Engineer): I can handle provisioning. Want the key created under the demo org (org_id: velo-42) or their guest sub-org? Also confirm allowed IPs and whether we need embedding access.
Alex (Account Executive): Use demo org velo-42. Only inference:generation scope, no embeddings. Allowed IPs: 18.208.45.12/32 and 18.208.45.13/32. TTL 8 hours. Please make it ephemeral and send revoke steps after.
Maria (Solutions Engineer): Got it. I'll create an ephemeral key via the provisioning API. Quick snippet (internal tooling):
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-admin.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"org_id":"velo-42","name":"velos-demo-ephemeral","scopes":["inference:generate"],"allowed_ips":["18.208.45.12/32","18.208.45.13/32"],"ttl_hours":8}'
```
Response includes `key_id` and `client_secret`. I'll paste the secret to the shared secure field and not here.
Jamie (Infra): Quick ops notes: 1) We enforce max TTL 24h for hosted POCs, 8h is fine. 2) Make sure `ops-bot` annotates key with `poctype:poc-demo` tag for auto-revocation audit. 3) No wildcard `allowed_ips` — must be exact CIDRs.
Maria (Solutions Engineer): I'll tag it. After creating I'll post the secret to LastPass Shared Notes under the Velos folder and ping Sales for pickup. For revocation we call the revoke endpoint or use Console: either works. Revoke command: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-admin.redwood.ai/v1/keys/REPLACE_KEY_ID/revoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
ops-bot: key_provision event recorded: key_id=kr_03Yw... created_by=maria_se ttl=8h tag=poctype:poc-demo
Alex (Account Executive): Thanks — can you also add a short rotation play (who revokes when demo ends)? We need PS to revoke immediately after the demo if they request.
Maria (Solutions Engineer): Will do. Plan: 1) I create key and store secret in shared vault. 2) Jamie (Infra) will set automatic revoke at T+9h as a safety net. 3) Sales or Velos rep confirms demo finish -> I run revoke API and post confirmation in this thread.
Jamie (Infra): I'll schedule the auto-revoke job (T+9h) and enable audit trail to log revoke reason. ops-bot will post the revoke event when done.
Alex (Account Executive): Perfect. Can you create the key now and drop the LastPass link here once done? :thumbsup:
Maria (Solutions Engineer): Creating now — will paste secure link when complete.
ops-bot: key_revoke_scheduled event recorded: key_id=kr_03Yw..., revoke_time=2367893923, scheduled_by=jamie_infra
Maria (Solutions Engineer): Link to vault: https://vault.company/velos/notes/velos-demo-ephemeral (access: sales@redwood, se@redwood). I revoked console preview so secret is not shown in-thread.
Alex (Account Executive): got it, thanks everyone. I will tell Velos to use the demo key only from their office IPs.
Maria (Solutions Engineer): After demo I'll run revoke and report back here.
ops-bot: audit_log event: user=maria_se action=create_key key_id=kr_03Yw... ip_bind=[18.208.45.12/32,18.208.45.13/32] ttl=8h
Alex (Account Executive): closing loop — please confirm when revoked.
Maria (Solutions Engineer): Revoked at 2367890300 via revoke API. Confirmation: key_id=kr_03Yw... revoked_by=maria_se reason=demo_complete.
ops-bot: key_revoke event recorded: key_id=kr_03Yw..., revoked_at=2367890300, revoked_by=maria_se
